selectors.kid: Self: whoever (or whatever) is running the command.
selectors.note: Inside /execute as ..., @s means the one it's doing it for right now. In a command block on its own, @s finds nothing.
In a command block, that's the player closest to the block.
On Bedrock, @r[type=cow] picks a random cow. On Java, use @e[type=cow,sort=random,limit=1] instead.

selectors.kid: Every entity: players, mobs, dropped items, arrows, boats... everything!
selectors.note: Almost always add a filter, like @e[type=zombie].

selectors.kid: The nearest entity of any kind, not just players.
selectors.note: @n[type=pig] is the closest pig. Same as @e[...,limit=1,sort=nearest] on Java, or @e[...,c=1] on Bedrock.

selectors.kid: The player who clicked a button on an NPC's talking window.
selectors.note: Only works in commands an NPC runs.

filters.title: Type of thing
filters.kid: Pick only one kind of mob or thing. Put ! in front to mean "everything except".

ex: Remove everything that isn't a player.
Make every undead mob glow. #minecraft:undead is a group (see below).
Remove everything that isn't a player.
Remove everything except players and dropped items.

filters.tip: Find every ID in the Mobs & more tab. Some are spelled differently on Java and Bedrock!

filters.title: Family (Bedrock) / Group (Java)
filters.kid: Pick a whole group of mobs at once, like all monsters or all undead.

ex: Remove monsters that are NOT undead. You can use family more than once.

filters.tip: Java groups use type= with a # in front. Bedrock uses family=. The group lists are at the bottom of this page.

filters.title: Name
filters.kid: Pick things with a certain name, like a pet you named with a name tag, or a player.

ex: Bring your pig named Bacon to you.
Bring your pig named Bacon to you.

filters.title: How far away
filters.kid: Only pick things within some number of blocks, or farther than some number of blocks.

j.form: distance=..10 (up to 10)   distance=5.. (5 or more)   distance=5..10
ex: Bring back everyone who wandered more than 50 blocks away.

b.form: r=10 (up to 10)   rm=5 (5 or more)   rm=5,r=10
ex: Bring back everyone who wandered more than 50 blocks away.

filters.tip: Distance is measured from where the command runs: you, or the command block.

filters.title: Start the search somewhere else
filters.kid: Measure distance from a different spot instead of from where the command runs.

filters.title: Inside a box
filters.kid: Pick things inside a box-shaped area. Start at x y z, then dx, dy and dz say how many blocks the box stretches east, up and south.

ex: Label everyone inside the arena box.
Heal anyone standing in a 5×3×5 healing zone.
Label everyone inside the arena box.
Heal anyone standing in a 5×3×5 healing zone.

filters.tip: Great in a Repeat command block for "zones": healing zones, no-build zones, finish lines.

filters.title: How many, and which ones
filters.kid: Pick only a certain number, like the 3 closest, the farthest one, or random ones.

ex: One lucky random player gets a diamond.
One lucky random player gets a diamond. (Use @r for random.)

filters.tip: Java needs both limit and sort. Bedrock's c does both: positive means closest, negative means farthest.

filters.title: Tag (label)
filters.kid: Pick things that have a label you added with /tag. Use ! for "doesn't have this label".

j.form: tag=<tag>   tag=!<tag>   tag= (no tags at all)
ex: Everyone who isn't a hero becomes a villain.

b.form: tag=<tag>   tag=!<tag>   tag= (no tags at all)
ex: Everyone who isn't a hero becomes a villain.

filters.tip: You can use tag more than once: [tag=red,tag=!out] means "has red AND doesn't have out".

filters.title: Score
filters.kid: Pick players (or mobs) by their score on the scoreboard.

ex: Everyone with 10 or more points gets a diamond.
Send players with 0 lives to the lobby.
Everyone with 10 or more points gets a diamond.
Send players with 0 lives to the lobby.

filters.tip: Ranges work like distance: 10.. means 10 or more, ..5 means 5 or less, 1..3 means 1 to 3. Make the score first with /scoreboard.

filters.title: Team
filters.kid: Pick players on a team you made with /team.

ex: Send the red team to their base.
Make everyone NOT on red glow.

filters.tip: Bedrock has no teams. Use tags instead: tag=red.

filters.title: Game mode
filters.kid: Pick players who are in Survival, Creative, Adventure or Spectator.

filters.title: XP level
filters.kid: Pick players by their experience level.

ex: Help players with 5 or fewer levels.
Help players with 5 or fewer levels.

filters.tip: On Bedrock, lm is the Minimum and l is the most.

filters.title: Advancements
filters.kid: Pick players who have (or haven't) earned an advancement.

ex: Reward players who've been to the Nether.

filters.title: Controls turned on or off
filters.kid: Pick players whose controls were turned on or off with /inputpermission.
filters.tip: Controls: camera, movement, jump, sneak, mount, dismount, lateral_movement, move_forward, move_backward, move_left, move_right.

filters.title: Looking up or down
filters.kid: Pick things by how far up or down they're looking. -90 is straight up, 0 is straight ahead, 90 is straight down.

filters.title: Facing north, south, east or west
filters.kid: Pick things by which way they're facing. 0 is south, 90 is west, 180 (or -180) is north, -90 is east.

filters.title: Has an item
filters.kid: Pick players or mobs carrying a certain item, even in a certain slot.

ex: Anyone with at least one diamond.
Holding a golden sword gives strength.
Take all the dirt from anyone with 64 or more.

filters.tip: Slots: slot.weapon.mainhand, slot.weapon.offhand, slot.armor.head, slot.armor.chest, slot.armor.legs, slot.armor.feet, slot.hotbar, slot.inventory, slot.enderchest. Java has no hasitem filter: use /execute if items entity @s weapon.mainhand diamond_sword run ... instead.

filters.title: Hidden data (NBT)
filters.kid: Pick things by their hidden details, like what they're holding or what color a sheep is.

ex: Holding a golden sword gives strength.
Anyone with a diamond anywhere in their inventory.
Only red sheep. 14 is the number for red.

filters.tip: Punctuation must be perfect. Checking NBT many times a second can cause lag. To check what a player is holding, /execute if items is faster.

filters.title: Predicate (data packs)
filters.kid: Pick things that pass a test written in a data pack. For advanced map makers.

ex: Only works if a data pack defines this test.

filters.title: Property (add-ons)
filters.kid: Pick mobs by a property that an add-on gave them. For advanced add-on makers.

ex: Only works if an add-on defines this property.

recipes.tip: Java has no single "monster" group, so this Java version finds undead ones.

recipes.what: Players standing on a diamond block
recipes.j: execute as @a at @s if block ~ ~-1 ~ diamond_block run ...
recipes.b: execute as @a at @s if block ~ ~-1 ~ diamond_block run ...
recipes.tip: That's a job for /execute, not a filter.

recipes.j: execute as @a if items entity @s weapon.mainhand diamond_sword run ...
recipes.tip: Java has no item filter, so use /execute if items. It also works with nbt=, but that can cause lag.

recipes.what: Every mob but not players, items or pets
Survival players who are NOT tagged "safe"
Players inside a 10×10 room starting at 0 60 0

java_groups.impact_projectiles: Things you throw or shoot that break when they hit something.

java_groups.fall_damage_immune: Mobs that don't get hurt from falling.
java_groups.followable_friendly_mobs: Friendly mobs that a baby animal might follow.
java_groups.beehive_inhabitors: Things that can live in a beehive.

bedrock_families.mob: Almost every living creature (not players, items or projectiles).
bedrock_families.undead: Undead mobs: zombies, skeletons, phantoms, the wither and more.
bedrock_families.zombie: Zombies, husks, drowned and zombie villagers.
bedrock_families.skeleton: Skeletons, strays, bogged, parched, wither skeletons and the wither.
bedrock_families.arthropod: Bugs: spiders, bees, silverfish and endermites.
bedrock_families.fish: Fish: cod, salmon, pufferfish and tropical fish.

bedrock_families.projectile: Arrows, snowballs, potions, fireballs and other flying things.
